predicates.description: JavaScript inline-cache or hidden-class feedback is irrelevant.; The important state is Liftoff's internal stack cache: two virtual stack slots map to one register and initially carry compatible reference metadata.; After the in-place conversion, one slot is updated as the externalized result while the other alias retains stale pre-conversion Wasm reference-type metadata.; A subsequent typed use trusts that stale metadata, exposing the value/type inconsistency.

predicates.name: invariant_signal
predicates.description: The operand register used by extern.externalize must be exclusively owned and safe to overwrite. PopToRegister could return a register still aliased by another Liftoff stack-cache value, so the conversion could mutate a shared register and leave another value represented with bits inconsistent with its Wasm reference type. PopToModifiableRegister breaks such aliases before modification.
